AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When should fruits be harvested? (1 mark)
   A. While green and hard
   B. Before flowers appear
   C. After they rot
   D. When they are ripe

2. At what depth should the seedling be planted? (1 mark)
   A. The same depth as it was in the bag
   B. Upside down
   C. Very deep
   D. On top of the ground

3. Which is likely to take longest to give fruit? (1 mark)
   A. Passion fruit
   B. Radish
   C. Mango tree
   D. Pawpaw

4. Which site is suitable for planting a fruit tree? (1 mark)
   A. A sunny place with space to spread
   B. Inside a building
   C. A deep shade under big trees
   D. A flooded area

5. Which nutrient in eggs helps the body to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Protein
   B. Sugar only
   C. Starch only
   D. Salt

6. What is the meat from cattle called? (1 mark)
   A. Pork
   B. Chicken
   C. Mutton
   D. Beef

7. What is the young one of a sheep called? (1 mark)
   A. Lamb
   B. Calf
   C. Kid
   D. Foal

8. What is a male sheep called? (1 mark)
   A. Billy
   B. Cock
   C. Bull
   D. Ram

9. Which meal is missing body-building foods? (1 mark)
   A. Ugali and sukuma wiki only
   B. Chapati, egg and tomato
   C. Rice, beans and cabbage
   D. Ugali, fish and spinach

10. Why is a food journal kept for a week? (1 mark)
   A. To improve handwriting only
   B. To check whether meals are balanced
   C. To find cheap shops
   D. To count the number of plates

11. Which is a cheap way of getting a balanced meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip meals
   B. Eat only sweets
   C. Grow vegetables and fruits at home
   D. Buy only expensive foods

12. Which meal is missing protective foods? (1 mark)
   A. Rice and fish only
   B. Githeri and avocado
   C. Sweet potato, egg and spinach
   D. Ugali, beans and cabbage

13. Who should be with a child who is cooking? (1 mark)
   A. A friend only
   B. Nobody
   C. An adult
   D. A younger child

14. Which is a disadvantage of too much frying? (1 mark)
   A. It removes all flavour
   B. It makes food cold
   C. It uses no heat
   D. Too much oil is not good for health

15. Which is an advantage of boiling? (1 mark)
   A. It needs no oil
   B. It always burns food
   C. It makes food black
   D. It needs deep oil

16. Why should food be dry before it is put into hot oil? (1 mark)
   A. Water makes food sweet
   B. Water makes hot oil splash
   C. Water makes oil cold
   D. Water makes oil colourless

17. Which disease can be spread by dirty hands? (1 mark)
   A. Sunburn
   B. Toothache only
   C. Diarrhoea
   D. Broken leg

18. Why should fingernails be kept short? (1 mark)
   A. Short nails grow faster
   B. Germs and worm eggs hide under long nails
   C. Nails are food
   D. Long nails are heavy

19. Which food is bad for teeth if eaten too often? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Sweets
   C. Water
   D. Eggs

20. Which PPE would you wear on your hands to handle dirty things? (1 mark)
   A. Dust mask
   B. Gumboots
   C. Gloves
   D. Headgear

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Design a hygiene log for one week. List five practices to record and explain how you will use it. (5 marks)

22. List three safety rules when harvesting fruit. (3 marks)

23. Give three uses of sheep. (3 marks)

24. Give three ways of caring for a fruit crop. (3 marks)

25. Why must fish be dried before shallow frying? (3 marks)

26. Describe how to shallow fry an egg. (4 marks)

27. Name two problems that can attack ripe fruits. (2 marks)

28. Name two woody fruit trees and two climbing fruit crops. (4 marks)

29. Why do some fruit trees take longer to give fruit than others? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — When they are ripe
   Ripe fruit is tastiest and has the most vitamins.

2. A — The same depth as it was in the bag
   Planting too deep can rot the stem.

3. C — Mango tree
   Big trees like mango take several years.

4. A — A sunny place with space to spread
   Fruit trees need light and space.

5. A — Protein
   Eggs are body-building foods.

6. D — Beef
   Beef comes from cattle.

7. A — Lamb
   A young sheep is a lamb.

8. D — Ram
   A ram is a male sheep.

9. A — Ugali and sukuma wiki only
   Ugali and kale give energy and vitamins but no protein food.

10. B — To check whether meals are balanced
   A journal shows patterns in eating.

11. C — Grow vegetables and fruits at home
   A kitchen garden gives fresh food.

12. A — Rice and fish only
   Rice and fish have energy and protein but no vegetables or fruits.

13. C — An adult
   An adult helps prevent accidents.

14. D — Too much oil is not good for health
   Too much oil can harm health.

15. A — It needs no oil
   Boiled food is low in fat.

16. B — Water makes hot oil splash
   Splashing oil can burn.

17. C — Diarrhoea
   Germs on hands can get into the mouth.

18. B — Germs and worm eggs hide under long nails
   Clean short nails prevent infection.

19. B — Sweets
   Sugar helps decay.

20. C — Gloves
   Gloves cover the hands.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: Practices: washed hands before meals, brushed teeth twice, bathed, clean clothes, drank safe water. Tick each day, count ticks at the end, and improve the practice with fewest ticks.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for practices and table, 2 marks for use.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use a ladder or picking pole; do not climb thin branches; wash hands and fruit; use both hands (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mutton, wool (some breeds), skins, manure, income (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each use.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watering, weeding, mulching, adding compost, pruning, protecting from animals (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wet food makes the hot oil splash, which can burn people, so the fish should be dried with a cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for splash, 1 for burns, 1 for drying.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Crack the egg into a bowl; heat a little oil in the pan; slide the egg in; cook until the white is firm; lift out with a spatula.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fruit flies, birds or monkeys (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Woody: guava, tree tomato, mango; climbing: passion fruit, grapes, kiwi, blackberry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct example.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Big trees such as mango grow slowly and need years before flowering, while pawpaw and passion fruit are small plants that fruit within about a year.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for slow trees, fast plants, and reason of size or type.
